How does it work?

  1. The user asks a question

    A parent, teacher or principal types or speaks their question, inside the platform they already use every day.

  2. The platform sends only authorised data

    After checking the user’s permissions, with names masked and phone numbers, emails and Massar codes removed.

  3. A clear answer in seconds

    Real names are restored in the answer, shown with the right link in the platform.

Student data stays protected

The service follows data minimisation to help schools comply with Moroccan law 09-08.

  • Pseudonymisation: every name is replaced with a code (e.g. [S12]) before sending, and restored only in the answer.
  • Automatic removal of phone numbers, emails, Massar codes and ID numbers; birth dates become ages.
  • Each user only sees what they are entitled to: a parent sees only their own children.
  • The text of questions and answers is not stored — only the number of requests and their cost.

Full control over usage and costs

Limits per feature and per user

A monthly limit per school and per tool, and a daily limit per user: no surprises on the bill.

The right model for each task

A fast, low-cost model for everyday questions and a more powerful one for reports.

A clear usage dashboard

Requests and estimated cost per school and per feature, month by month.

Building a school platform? Use the service through the API

KidsNotices AI is a standalone service that works with any school management platform: one key per platform, schools linked to the key, monthly quotas and usage reports for billing.

  • Simple JSON API
  • Drop-in PHP client, no Composer needed
  • Built-in pseudonymisation
  • Ready-to-embed smart search page

Frequently asked questions

Does the assistant understand Moroccan Darija?

Yes. It understands Darija, Modern Standard Arabic and French, and answers in the parent’s language (in simple Arabic when the message is in Darija).

Can it make up grades or dates?

The assistant is set up to answer only from the school data it receives. If the information isn’t there, it says so and points the parent to the administration. Every answer is labelled as AI-generated.

Is student data safe?

Names are replaced with codes before reaching the AI, phone numbers, emails and Massar codes are removed, and conversation text is not stored.

Does it replace school staff?

No. It handles repetitive questions and routine writing, so staff and teachers can focus on students and on situations that need a human.

Can a platform other than KidsNotices use it?

Yes. The service is available through an API for any school platform, with its own key, linked schools and monthly quotas.
